name: What is involved in a kitchen expansion?

mainEntity.name: What is involved in a kitchen expansion?

acceptedAnswer.text: A kitchen expansion enlarges your cooking space either by taking down interior walls to absorb adjacent rooms or by building an exterior bump-out addition. Blue Lake Construction assesses your home's structural framing to determine whether interior reconfiguration or an exterior extension fits best. Reconfiguring interior space by removing non-load-bearing walls or adding support beams keeps work within the existing footprint. In contrast, an exterior bump-out requires foundation work and exterior siding integration, providing significant square footage without sacrificing surrounding dining or living areas.
